propositions: Dependabot PR #131 pins five package updates (botocore, genai-prices, json-repair, mypy, ruff) to versions that must be landed via Gerrit since GitHub is read-only.
Bumping lint and typecheck tools (ruff 0.16.3, mypy 2.3.1) must be verified to surface no new code findings or rule violations anywhere in the tree.
Lock file must be regenerated with the project's uv workflow to current resolver versions, not hand-edited or pinned to stale PR versions.
Complexity baseline and pre-commit hooks must remain unchanged after the tool upgrade, with zero new findings, increased violations, or stale ratchet drift.
PR #131 must be confirmed closed after Gerrit merge lands to main and GitHub mirror syncs; if not auto-closed by dependabot, close manually with Gerrit change reference.
